about: Made by tests/Feature/ScaleScorePackageCasesTest.php of the platform from its own cases (tests/fixtures/scale-score/cases.json, SPECS §75.6) — do not edit; UPDATE_PACKAGE_FIXTURES=1 writes it again. Per case: the API codebook of the matrix rows, one response as stored (a row a condition hides is empty), the items, the method (mean or sum), min_items (null: the default, every item) and the score the platform gives (null: none).
